svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Ablation 2 — Model Armor screening OFF vs ON, text-carrier drill fixtures only
svg.desc: With screening on, 9 of 9 text-carrier drill fixtures were blocked at the screen and none reached a model. With screening off, 7 of the 8 scoreable fixtures steered the fleet to approve; one of the nine errored on a 503 and is unscoreable. Text carriers only: the 6 PDF-carrier fixtures have no unscreened ingestion path and are excluded, so this arm is never quoted against the 15-fixture denominator.
svg.text: Ablation 2 — Model Armor screening OFF vs ON
Two arms that measure two different things, placed side by side and never subtracted. Counts of drill fixtures — not percentages, not a rate.
Scope: TEXT CARRIERS ONLY — 9 of the 15 injection-gate fixtures.

g.text: Read this chart with its four caveats
1. Text carriers only. The 6 PDF-carrier fixtures have
no unscreened ingestion path, so they cannot ride the
OFF arm. This chart is never quoted against the
2. No no-injection control arm exists. "7 of 8 approved"
is a strong indicator the embedded instructions worked,
not proof of obedience — some of those synthetic
applications might have been approved on their merits.
3. The two arms measure different things. ON counts
screening-layer blocks; OFF counts downstream behaviour.
4. Canary leaks were 0 on both arms. The shipped gate
number over the whole 15-fixture corpus is a separate
only with its provenance (B-014 reporting rule).

svg.text: the 7-of-8 decomposition and the no-control caveat from the README "Ablation 2" section. Hand-authored 2026-08-29, nothing re-measured.
Defensive drill fixtures (ADR-006): they exist to validate CivicNexus's own guardrails and never leave the drill path.
